MATCH (m:Model) WHERE m.id IN ['nvidia/LocateAnything-3B','Qwen/Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct','Qwen/Qwen2.5-3B'] OPTIONAL MATCH (m)-[:DECLARES]->(l:Licence) RETURN m.id AS model, m.licence AS licence_field, collect(l.id) AS declared
MATCH path = (m:Model {id: 'mudler/locate-anything.cpp-gguf'})-[:DERIVED_FROM*1..]->(a:Model)-[:DECLARES]->(l:Licence) RETURN DISTINCT l.id AS ancestor_licence
